headline: Sent Scott Truhart's open meeting complaint to the City Solicitor's office for response to the Attorney General, 5-0.
summary: Scott Truhart filed a complaint saying he was not called on during public comment at an October 21, 2026 meeting. Staff planner Brennan Postich gave his account, which said only one member of the public spoke before comment closed. Staff recommended sending the matter to the City Solicitor's office, and members voted 5-0 to do so.

plain_text:
City of Salem Zoning Board of Appeals 
DRAFT Meeting Minutes 
November 5, 2026 
 
A special meeting of the Salem Zoning Board of Appeals (“Salem ZBA”) was held on Wednesday, 
November 5, 2026, at 6:30 pm via remote participation in accordance with Section 30A of Chapter 
20 of the Acts of 2021, as amended by Section 40 of Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2023, and further 
amended by Section 1 of Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025, the City is authorized to conduct remote 
meetings of its public bodies through June 30, 2027.  
 
Chair Nina Vyedin calls the meeting to order at 6:30 pm. 
Chair Vyedin explains how individuals can participate in the meeting remotely via Zoom, and that 
instructions to participate remotely can also be found on the Salem website.  Ms. Vyedin notes the 
Board will not be taking public comment at this meeting, but explains how those requiring auxiliary 
aids and services may contact the City of Salem ADA coordinator as soon as possible in less than 
two days before the meeting, program, or event. 
 
ROLL CALL  
Those present were: Chair Nina Vyedin, Vice Chair Christa McGaha, Secretary Ellen Simpson, Peter 
Habib, and Hilary Forbes.  Also in attendance were Brennan Postich — Staff Planner.  Those absent 
were: Samantha Stringfellow and Stephen Larrick. 
 
REGULAR AGENDA   
 
None. 
 
   
MEETING MINUTES 
 
None 
 
   
OLD/NEW BUSINESS  
 
Acknowledgement, review, and discussion of the Open Meeting Law Complaint filed by Scott 
Truhart on October 22, 2026. 
 
Chair Vyedin reads the complaint, which states that during the October 21, 2026 ZBA meeting the 
Chair opened the floor to public comment, and despite raising his hand most of the meeting, Mr. 
Truhart alleges he was ignored and that only one member from the public was called upon.  He 
states staff was aware of his intent to speak and provide comment.  The requested action is to re-
hold this section of the meeting at the next regularly scheduled meeting. 
 
Mr. Postich provides his recollection of the meeting, in which the Board opened the 1-3 East Collins 
Street petition for Board discussion, at which point Mr. Truhart raised his hand.  The Chair then 
opened the petition up for public comment, at which point Mr. Truhart lowered his hand.  Seeing 
no further hands raised after the one public commenter, the public comment period was closed,

according to Mr. Postich.  Staff recommendation is to delegate the matter to the City Solicitor’s 
office for response to the office to the Attorney General. 
 
Chair Vyedin asks the Board if there is any different memory of the evening and there is no 
comment.  She notes that the Board is always interested in hearing public commentary as long as it 
is within the allotted time. 
 
Motion and Vote: Ms. Simpson motions to delegate this matter to the City Solicitor’s Office for 
response to the Office of the Attorney General. 
 
Ms. Forbes seconds the motion.  The vote is five (5) in favor (Nina Vyedin, Christa McGaha, 
Ellen Simpson, Peter Habib, and Hilary Forbes.) and none (0) opposed.  The motion 
passes. 
 
   
 
Next Meeting 
November 18, 2026 
 
   
ADJOURNMENT 
  
Motion and Vote: Ms. McGaha motions to adjourn the meeting.  Mr. Habib seconds the motion.  
The vote is all in favor.  The motion passes.  
 
The meeting ends at 6:38 PM on November 5, 2026.  
 
For actions where the decisions have not been fully written into these minutes, copies of the  
Decisions have been posted separately by address or project at:  
https://www.salem.com/zoning-board-appeals/pages/zoning-board-appeals-decisions-2026  
 
Respectfully submitted,  
Brennan Postich, Staff Planner
